payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image change the background into a basketball court?
node.criteria: complete: the background reads as a basketball court from the visible combined court-specific cues, such as a hoop with court markings or playing surface; a full court need not be visible. A basketball-themed backdrop alone, such as basketballs or a hoop without enough context to read as a court, is not complete. partial: the background has genuinely progressed toward a basketball court but does not meet that completion criterion. absent: no progress toward changing the background into a basketball court. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress.
node.binding: The image background; assess whether it depicts a basketball court, not merely basketball-themed objects.

outcome.description: Change the image background into a basketball court.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited background depicts a basketball playing surface with visible court markings and a hoop, so it reads as a basketball court rather than only a basketball-themed backdrop.","confidence":0.99}
